text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each repair is fitted on odd ISO weeks of the valid time and scored on even weeks, then the reverse. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole weeks of forecast start (13 weeks). Rule at 0: same error. Five Primary substations, June to August, valid 09:00 to 15:00 UTC, 1 to 4 days ahead, forecasts from experiment 46.'
